messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images, using the front-view reference for the front hairstyle shape and the back-view reference for the back hairstyle shape. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with hands on hips, raises one arm, then turns to face the camera while gesturing near her face and shifting her weight.","camera":"A static high-angle, slightly tilted wide shot keeps the character centered on the tiled floor.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting romper with a multicolored geometric pattern in pink, purple, yellow, blue, and black, plus red flat shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black with a bright blue top section.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair with a small blue topknot or bun on top of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and then in profile.","scene":"An outdoor tiled plaza with a reflective metal strip on the left, a textured gray ground area on the right, and pale building walls in the background under warm sunlight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair changed from a smooth blue cap-like style to a shorter, textured dark style with a small blue topknot/bun and more visible hair strands, while the character, clothing, scene, camera, and animation remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the character's hairstyle to match the front and back reference images while preserving identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Whether the new hairstyle closely matches the detailed front and back reference shapes, since the output hair remains small and partly obscured by the character's pose and angle.
